subject: Vendor activation: buyer intake + remit/ACH details needed
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@equitylabs.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor activation: buyer intake + remit/ACH details needed

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. We're ready to kick off vendor activation for Equity Labs so our payments and procurement teams can issue POs and route payment. To keep this quick, can you provide the following items by EOD Friday (or let us know which ones you need more time on):

• Legal business name (exact as on tax forms) and any DBAs
• Entity type and jurisdiction of formation + Certificate of Incorporation (PDF)
• Federal Tax ID / EIN (or VAT ID for non-US entities)
• W-9 (US) or equivalent tax form for your jurisdiction
• Remit-to address for invoicing (physical + billing email)
• Primary ACH details: bank name, account type, routing number (ABA) and account number — we accept a bank letter instead of account number if preferred
• Wire details (beneficiary name, SWIFT/BIC, intermediary bank if required)
• Preferred PO and invoice routing (billing@ or finance@) and any required PO reference text
• Any special payment terms or vendor onboarding requirements (e.g., invoice template, holdbacks)

I've attached our buyer intake form and a one-page checklist (link below) — filling the form speeds the process. Grace and Evelyn from finance are looped in for the PO workflow and tax verification.

Attachments: buyer-intake-form-2027.pdf (fillable), vendor-onboarding-checklist.pdf
Links: https://drive.redwood.ai/forms/buyer-intake-2027

Next steps: once we receive the items above our AP team will validate tax docs and bank details, create a vendor record, and issue the first PO (you'll get an automated PO email). If anything needs redlines (vendor agreement), we can route to legal but typically the PO + standard terms are sufficient.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation on timing.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Sophie — that's perfect and very helpful. Quick follow-ups from AP:

1) For ACH setup we need either: the full account+routing in a secure message from Daniel, OR a bank letter with the full routing and a masked account plus a confirmation step (micro-deposits). Which do you prefer?

2) Please confirm the invoicing email to use on the PO (we typically put the billing email on the PO so invoices route automatically). You listed billing@equitylabs.com — confirm that's monitored by your AP team.

3) Any required remittance advice format? (CSV columns, PO#, invoice #)

If Daniel is comfortable, he can reply with the preferred ACH approach and send the full bank details to ap-secure@redwood.ai — that's an HSM-encrypted mailbox we use for bank details. If you'd rather do micro-deposits, indicate that and we'll kick off verification (typically 1-2 business days).

Once we have that we can create the vendor record and issue the PO; Grace will take point on PO creation and Evelyn will do tax verification.

—Marcus
